metadata.description: Widget configuration dictionary containing 'type' key and widget-specific parameters (e.g., start, stop, value, options).
Mapping of widget type identifiers to marimo widget class paths (e.g., {'slider': 'mo.ui.slider'}). If not provided, a default mapping is used.
If true, enables debug logging at each processing step. Defaults to false.
Optional dictionary of environment variable overrides to apply at runtime.
